pack: Pelag Anchor Throw (Бросок якоря) motion reference, Higgsfield

poses.1: ready: grip in both hands, anchor hanging on ~1 m of chain at the right side
poses.2: wind-up: anchor swung back on the chain behind the right shoulder
poses.3: throw release: right arm whips forward, chain pays out straight
poses.4: full reach: chain taut, body braced
poses.5: yank back: both hands pull hard, leaning back on the back foot
poses.6: catch/recover: anchor swings back to his side, chain sagging
